top_examples.hook: My girlfriend said she packed me sweet lunch notes, but every message I opened sounded like she was furious with me.
top_examples.premise: A man discovers that the handwritten notes his girlfriend leaves in his lunch keep being replaced with much harsher messages before he opens them.
top_examples.title: Someone Replaced My Girlfriend's Lunch Notes

top_examples.hook: A restaurant accused me of cheating its rewards program because I somehow ate thirty-seven dinners in a city I hadn't visited.
top_examples.premise: A man keeps receiving restaurant loyalty points for expensive dinners he never ate, then gets accused of abusing the rewards program.
top_examples.title: I Somehow Ate 37 Dinners in Another City

top_examples.hook: I opened my freezer and found three bags of meat half thawed for the second time in a month.
top_examples.premise: A man realizes his neighbor has been unplugging his hallway freezer to charge an electric scooter.
top_examples.title: My Neighbor Kept Unplugging My Freezer at Night

top_examples.hook: My aunt tasted our family recipe and asked why I had changed Grandma's secret ingredient. I hadn't.
top_examples.premise: A woman discovers her sister has been secretly replacing sentimental family recipes with easier versions before a reunion cookbook is printed.
top_examples.title: Someone Rewrote Grandma's Recipes

top_examples.hook: My nephew thanked me for a birthday card, then asked why I wrote 'enjoy the fifty dollars' when there was no money inside.
top_examples.premise: A woman discovers her aunt has been quietly removing cash gifts from birthday cards before handing them to younger relatives.
top_examples.title: The Birthday Money Kept Disappearing Before the Cake
